localized.zh_cn: 来自神化的联动：宝藏书架允许为普通可损耗物品抽选修复附魔；仍遵守神化的附魔强度和黑名单。
localized.en_us: Apotheosis integration: Treasure Shelves let ordinary damageable items roll Repair, subject to enchanting power and blacklists.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘万象
localized.en_us: Thaumic Omniverse

localized.zh_cn: 注魔法附魔上限已调整：使用神化上限再加一级；本体关闭增强模式时也生效。
localized.en_us: Infusion enchanting uses the Apotheosis cap plus one level, including when core enhanced enchanting is off.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘万象
localized.en_us: Thaumic Omniverse

localized.zh_cn: 第三方附魔已加入注魔：完成“通用注魔附魔”即可解锁该组配方，各配方仍独立付费。
localized.en_us: Third-party enchantments gain infusion recipes through the single Universal Infusion Enchantments research, retaining individual recipe costs.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘万象
localized.en_us: Thaumic Omniverse

localized.zh_cn: 来自机械动力的联动：液态灵气或充能器可付费修复带修复附魔的物品。
localized.en_us: Create integration: liquid aura and vis chargers can pay to restore items bearing Repair.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘万象
localized.en_us: Thaumic Omniverse

localized.zh_cn: 来自机械动力的联动：充能器可为经过的传送带物品补充魔力。
localized.en_us: Create integration: vis chargers recharge items passing on belts.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘万象
localized.en_us: Thaumic Omniverse

localized.zh_cn: 来自机械动力的联动：坩埚可用独立输入／输出槽接受催化剂并送出产物；自动配方不检查真人研究，仍完整支付源质。
localized.en_us: Create integration: crucibles use separate input/output slots for catalysts and products. Automated crafting skips player research checks but pays all essentia.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘万象
localized.en_us: Thaumic Omniverse

localized.zh_cn: 来自机械动力的联动：基座可接传送带、漏斗和机械手，支持序列组装；注魔可取用动态结构源质，仪式仍需手动开启。
localized.en_us: Create integration: pedestals accept belts, funnels, deployers and sequenced assembly. Infusion can draw contraption essentia but must still be started manually.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘万象
localized.en_us: Thaumic Omniverse

localized.zh_cn: 来自机械动力的联动：钻孔机可随动态结构运行，沿用核心、镐、耐久与魔力费用，产物进入结构库存；移动扫描参数上限为32。
localized.en_us: Create integration: bores operate on contraptions using their focus, pickaxe, durability and vis, sending output to contraption storage; the moving scan parameter is capped at 32.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘万象
localized.en_us: Thaumic Omniverse

localized.zh_cn: 来自机械动力的联动：魔镜可接收传送带物品，向传送带或开放容器输出；堵塞时缓存产物，也支持移动结构。
localized.en_us: Create integration: mirrors accept belt items and output to belts or open containers, buffering blocked output and supporting contraptions.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘万象
localized.en_us: Thaumic Omniverse

localized.zh_cn: 来自机械动力的联动：结构装配与还原保留傀儡绑定和标记，傀儡可追踪移动目标。
localized.en_us: Create integration: assembly and disassembly preserve golem bindings and markers, allowing golems to follow moving targets.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘万象
localized.en_us: Thaumic Omniverse

localized.zh_cn: 傀儡避险已扩展：识别已登记的附属尖刺、带刺围栏、特殊危险流体与暮色滑块。
localized.en_us: Golem hazard avoidance includes registered addon spikes, wired fences, dangerous fluids and Twilight Forest sliders.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘万象
localized.en_us: Thaumic Omniverse

localized.zh_cn: 来自灵魂核心的修改：假玩家使用已绑定的灵魂法杖时可取得绑定者研究知识；真人仍使用自身知识。
localized.en_us: Soul Core integration: fake players using a bound soul wand can act with its owner’s research; real players still use their own knowledge.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘万象
localized.en_us: Thaumic Omniverse

localized.zh_cn: 来自车万女仆的联动：女仆穿戴符文装备也可获得护盾，其施法同时使用装备的减耗与潜能。
localized.en_us: Touhou Little Maid integration: equipped runic gear grants maids shielding, with equipment discounts and Potency also applied to casting.

localized.en_us: Thaumic Omniverse

localized.zh_cn: 活化工具台新增充能：上方的本体充能器可为台内法杖充能，并付费修复带修复附魔的物品。
localized.en_us: Animation Tablets accept vis charging from the core charger above and paid repairs for items bearing Repair.

localized.en_us: Ancient Magical Forests generate inside magical forests, replacing the blue variant and multiplying node attempts there by four.

localized.zh_cn: 金属嬗变已扩展：按当前材料标签生成可用金属的嬗变和矿簇路线。
localized.en_us: Metal transmutation expands to available materials through current tags and ore-cluster routes.

localized.zh_cn: 来自神化的联动：神秘系列附魔可按各自适用物品、强度与黑名单在神化附魔台抽选。
localized.en_us: Apotheosis integration: Thaumcraft-family enchantments can roll at its table, respecting item eligibility, power and blacklists.

localized.en_us: Apotheosis attribute integration is adjusted: All Stats gems no longer increase Thaumcraft’s custom attributes.
